v5.10.16 - Unity Cup Elite Team option
Added ----- - Unity Cup: a new "Prefer Elite Team Opponent" setting (off by default) deliberately seeks out and challenges the pink-highlighted "Elite Team" opponent at the 4th Preseason race when one is offered, instead of picking based on race-prediction favorability. Beating it unlocks a stronger Team Zenith in the Finals with better rewards.
